notes:
Top-level: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary use: in-product chat assistant + semantic search (embeddings) + reranking of search results. Evaluated Hosted API first — fast dev velocity, liked streaming and observability. Now moving to Dedicated POC to validate unit economics and consistent latency at scale.

POC goals (customer):
- 99th p50/p95 latency targets: p50 < 80ms token, p95 < 350ms across peak traffic
- Embedding throughput: 2000 reqs/min with batch latencies under 300ms
- Cost break-even at ~1.2M tokens/day
- No exposure of customer data to multi-tenant logs; VPC peering and KMS mandatory

Technical constraints / asks:
- VPC-only control plane for Dedicated instance; strict egress rules
- SSO via SAML + IdP (Okta) + SCIM provisioning
- Retention controls: 90 days logs, option for extended 1 year for audit
- Want model variant routing: base model for most traffic + quantized cheaper model for bulk reranking

POC plan highlights (agreed 2026-03-10):
- Canary rollout: 5% traffic to Dedicated canary pool running model-v1 (fp16, opt-tuned); rest on Hosted as control
- Metric gates: latency, token error rate, cost per token, output quality (BLEU-like prompt eval + manual prompt sets)
notes_continued:
- Fallback routing: automatic fallback to Hosted API model-v1-compatible if Dedicated pool crosses latency or error thresholds; region failover to us-east-1 -> us-west-2 sequence if cross-region latency spikes >50ms; automatic rollback to previous model variant if QA eval drops >3% relative to baseline.
- Model variants: running 1) redwood-open-7b (fp16) as primary, 2) redwood-open-7b-quant (4-bit) as cost-optimized reranker, 3) redwood-open-13b (fp16) for complex longform chat on demand. Canary to test combination policy routing.
- Observability: need token-level cost, per-route latency, and per-prompt quality tracing. Requested additional retention for trace logs for 90d.

Operational/Org notes:
- Buying committee: CTO (Marta Reyes), Head of Product (Ben Holt), Infra Lead (Roxanne Li), Procurement (Jared Bloom).
- Concern: network team requires detailed VPC architecture + IAM diagram before finance will sign commitment.
- Quote request: committed Dedicated pool 4x A100 equiv or equivalent GPUs; initial term 12 months. Finance wants breakpoints at 6/12/24 months.

Stated quotes from calls: "We need a predictable tail latency, if the p95 moves we can't ship this feature" — CTO.
